pack: Nerd pack (Hitchhiker's Guide, Archer, Bond, Star Trek, Discworld, Tolkien)
note: Optional pack: --characters nerd. Each agent gets one name from its role's list, picked by a hash of its name so it keeps it. 'aside' is shown only on hover and in empty states, never as a line on the tile.

chief.name: M
chief.aside: Bring the slices back in one piece.

chief.name: Deep Thought
chief.aside: The answer is 42. The question is on the board.

chief.name: Jean-Luc Picard
chief.aside: Make it so. Then verify it.

chief.name: Lord Vetinari
chief.aside: The queue flows because I allow it to.

chief.name: Malory Archer
chief.aside: Do you want a stalled queue? Because that's how you get a stalled queue.

chief.name: Gandalf
chief.aside: A slice is never late. It ships precisely when it means to.

manager.name: Miss Moneypenny
manager.aside: He'll see your slice now. Briefly.

manager.name: Ford Prefect
manager.aside: Know where your towel is. And your backlog.

manager.name: Cyril Figgis
manager.aside: I'm the comptroller. I control the comps.

manager.name: William Riker
manager.aside: Number One, reporting. Shields up, queue full.

manager.name: Captain Carrot
manager.aside: Everyone has a slice. That's only fair.

manager.name: Elrond
manager.aside: You have been summoned here to clear the queue.

worker.name: Arthur Dent
worker.aside: I never could get the hang of Thursdays.

worker.name: Slartibartfast
worker.aside: I did the fjords. This module is nothing.

worker.name: Dr. Krieger
worker.aside: It's not a bug. It's a clone.

worker.name: Cheryl Tunt
worker.aside: I'm bored. Give me the dangerous slice.

worker.name: Montgomery Scott
worker.aside: I'm giving her all she's got!

worker.name: Geordi La Forge
worker.aside: Reroute it through the deflector array.

worker.name: Rincewind
worker.aside: Running away is a perfectly valid strategy.

worker.name: Samwise Gamgee
worker.aside: I can't carry the slice, but I can carry you.

worker.name: Gimli
worker.aside: And my axe. And my unit tests.

worker.name: Ponder Stibbons
worker.aside: Hex says it should work. Hex is usually right.

verifier.name: Marvin
verifier.aside: Brain the size of a planet, and they ask me to run the tests.

verifier.name: Q
verifier.aside: Now pay attention. I'll only check it once.

verifier.name: Commander Vimes
verifier.aside: Who watches the diffs? I do.

verifier.name: Odo
verifier.aside: Nobody commits on my promenade unchecked.

researcher.name: Hari Seldon
researcher.aside: I've modelled the next thousand slices.

researcher.name: Radagast
researcher.aside: I've been reading the bark. And the logs.

other.name: Eddie the Computer
other.aside: Hi there! This is going to be a great slice!
